whyBuy.title: Why Do **Instagram Likes Still Matter?**
whyBuy.body:
Instagram removed public like counts in some regions, but likes still drive the algorithm behind the scenes. Every like your post receives signals to Instagram that the content is worth pushing to more people.

When your posts land with strong like counts from the start, the algorithm treats them as high-performing content. That means more reach, more visibility on the Explore page, and more organic engagement coming in without extra effort from you.

Low like counts do the opposite. Even good content gets buried when the initial engagement signal is weak. Buying Instagram likes fixes that first impression and gives your content the algorithmic boost it needs to perform.

Here is what stronger like counts do for your posts:

- Push your content higher in hashtag and Explore feed results
- Increase the chance of landing on the Instagram Explore page
- Signal quality to the algorithm, triggering wider organic distribution
- Make your posts look credible to new visitors checking your profile
